name: claude-code-manager
description: Manage Claude Code CLI sessions: spawn, switch, monitor, and organize agent terminals from within VS Code.

claudeCodeManager.sessionType.description: Default kind of session to create from 'New Session'. 'terminal' spawns the Claude Code CLI in an integrated terminal (full control). 'extension' opens a tab in the official Anthropic Claude Code VS Code extension; sessions are tracked here as shadow entries with limited actions.
enumDescriptions: Spawn the `claude` CLI in a new integrated terminal
Open a tab in the official anthropic.claude-code extension via vscode://anthropic.claude-code/open

claudeCodeManager.cliPath.description: Path or command name for the Claude Code CLI.

claudeCodeManager.defaultArgs.description: Default arguments passed when spawning a new session (e.g. ["--model", "claude-opus-4-7"]).

claudeCodeManager.shell.description: Override shell for sessions. Leave empty to use VS Code's default integrated terminal shell.

claudeCodeManager.confirmKill.description: Ask for confirmation before killing a session.

claudeCodeManager.statusBar.enabled.description: Show a Claude session counter in the status bar.

claudeCodeManager.restoreOnActivate.description: On activation, what to do with sessions saved from a previous workspace launch.

claudeCodeManager.autoStatus.enabled.description: Auto-detect session status (Idle/Busy/Question/Permission/Done) by tailing the JSONL logs Claude Code writes under ~/.claude/projects/.

claudeCodeManager.autoStatus.permissionT.description: How long a session can sit in Busy with a pending tool_use before being escalated to Permission. Lower = snappier reaction when Claude pauses to ask permission, but long-running tools (Bash, etc.) may briefly look like permission waits.

claudeCodeManager.autoExit.idleMs.description: Mark a session as Exited when its JSONL log hasn't been written for this long (ms). Set to 0 to disable. Closed extension tabs and dormant CLI sessions get flipped to Exited so the 'Clear closed' button can purge them.

claudeCodeManager.autoRename.enabled.description: Auto-rename sessions to the task title that Claude Code derives, replacing the random initial name. Manual renames pin the name and disable further auto-renames for that session.

claudeCodeManager.notifications.mode.description: How to surface sessions that need attention (Question / Permission states).
enumDescriptions: Show a VS Code information notification with a Focus button

claudeCodeManager.showAllWindows.description: Show Claude sessions running in other VS Code windows on this machine. External sessions are read-only — click a card to bring the owning window forward.

claudeCodeManager.autoDiscovery.enabled.description: Periodically scan ~/.claude/projects/<cwd>/ for active JSONL files and adopt sessions started outside of this manager (e.g. via the official Claude Code extension or a bare `claude` CLI). Picked-up sessions appear as Extension shadow entries with auto-status enabled.

claudeCodeManager.autoDiscovery.interval.description: How often (in ms) to scan for new sessions when auto-discovery is enabled.

claudeCodeManager.autoDiscovery.freshnes.description: Only adopt JSONL files whose last write happened within this many ms. Older files are considered dormant and skipped.
